wording_corrections.25-9044: Postsecondary assistants mainly prepare instructional materials, lead discussions, administer examinations and grade work. Some direct human mentoring can matter, but support for a valued professor is not itself essential demand.
wording_corrections.25-1193: Teaching recreation, leisure and fitness studies mainly supplies professional knowledge. Human mentorship and role modeling can carry a premium, while instruction in physiology, program design and facilities management remains largely instrumental.
wording_corrections.39-9011: This estimate assumes sustained human care and attachment account for more demand than in instruction-focused preschool teaching. Practical supervision remains derived, while families may specifically want a real human caring for their child.
